Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this game. We expected a tough fight but it was another one-sided game of cricket in India but the twist in the tale was that it was the hosts who were decimated at their own backyard. Australia go 1-0 up in this small series with a dominant fashion. India will look to bounce back from this loss and will see this as one-off. We now move to Rajkot for the all important 2nd ODI. That game will be played on Friday, 17th January. The match will begin at 1330 local (0800 GMT). Join us for that one. Till then, cheers!

For his unbeaten knock of 128, David Warner has been adjudged the Man of the Match. Warner says that he has always had hunger and desire to score runs., Credits his fast bowlers and tells knocking India for 255 in their own backyard was incredible. Adds Finch started well and that allowed him to take his time. Says they just try to keep rotating the strike in the middle period and score odd boundaries. Tell they look to take the game deep and knew if they stuck in there till the end they could chase it with ease. Tells he enjoys fielding since childhood and used to get his clothes dirty which his mom did not like but he loves that aspect of the game. Ends by thanking the fans for coming.

Australian skipper, Aaron Finch says they fought back in the middle part with the ball and that played a huge role and he is proud of his bowlers. Finch says they can brush up in fielding but he is happy with the performance overall. On David Warner, Finch says that he has been unstoppable in this format. Tells that it is difficult to bowl to him once he is set in. Adds that it is always great to bat with him. On whether he expects India to bounce back, Finch says definitely as he knows they are a quality side.

Indian skipper Virat Kohli says that they were outplayed in all three departments. Adds that there was no intent in the middle overs with the bat and that the side was too respectful of the opposition bowlers. Further says that the Australians are a world class side and they capitalized on the openings that they got. On being asked about looking forward to the T20 format, Virat says International cricket is always priceless and game time matters and not a particular format. Adds that everyone has to step up and hopes that one of the youngsters in the middle order can play a blinder in the next two games. On being asked about his decision to come in at the number 4 position, Virat says that they have had that discussion many times in the past but they will be looking to try different things and not sticking to a single attempt. Adds that they were looking to experiment and they are allowed to do that and fail in that too once in a while. Ends by thanking the crowd and saying they were amazing.

Earlier in the day, the Australian bowlers set up the win for the tourists as they bowled out India for a paltry score of 255 on a batting pitch. No one apart from Dhawan and Rahul got going for India. The Australian bowlers were on top and the pace bowling trio of Starc, Cummins and Richardson grabbed 7 wickets amongst them with the former picking up 3 and the latter two sharing 4 wickets equally between themselves.

It was a day to forget for India. First with the bat and then with the ball. The bowlers had a sub-par total to defend but the way the Australian openers took the attack to them was something that we have not seen for a long, long time. 5 bowlers played the game and none of them had anything to smile about. Only the spinners went for less than 6 runs per over but that was because the Australian openers never had to go after them. Shami, Thakur and Bumrah they all went for over 7 rpo. A nightmare of a day for the Indian bowlers and they will like to forget this as quickly as possible.

Easily done! Australia made a mockery of this chase and have taken the lead in the series without sweating. The openers started, laid the platform and also ended the chase. Unbeaten centuries from David Warner and skipper Aaron Finch has  destroyed, humiliated and annihilated the hosts. A day for the Australians to remember as they have broken a ton of records and handed Australia a thumping 10 wicket win!

FOUR! That will be it! AUSTRALIA WIN BY 10 WICKETS! Unbelievable! Shami bowls a full ball on off, Warner drives this through mid off and the ball has raced away to the fence. Warner and Finch have been brilliant throughout and celebrations all around.
FOUR! Easy pickings! Back of a length ball on the body, Warner goes back and pulls this one behind square for a boundary. Australia need just 2 runs to win now.
Wide! Bouncer on middle and off, Warner ducks under it.
Full ball on off, pushed down to the man at mid off.
Length ball on off, pulled towards the man at square leg.
On the pads of Warner, he flicks this one towards mid-wicket for a single and he will keep strike.
Flatter delivery outside off, Warner cuts this one towards point and takes a couple.
On the pads, now Finch changes ends by flicking it towards square leg for one.
Darted on off to Finch, played towards the point region.
On the pads, worked towards square leg for a single.
Darted on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
Another full ball on middle, Warner plays this one towards mid on for a single.
Yorker on off, Warner digs it out towards cover.
Bouncer on middle and off, Warner looks to go for the upper cut but misses.
Another one outside off, played towards point for a single.
FOUR! Another length ball outside off, Finch opens the face of his bat and guides this one towards third man and the ball races away for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Finch plays this one towards point for a couple.
Mohammed Shami is back on.
Flighted on off, Finch defends it with soft hands and gets a single.

FOUR! CENTURY FOR DAVID WARNER! The Australian skipper now joins his partner. Jadeja gives him a chance to score a century by bowling one down the leg side. Finch gets down on one knee and sweeps it fine down the leg side for a boundary. Finch hugs his partner and then removes his bat and helmet as his teammates get on their feet and applaud their skipper's efforts. Captain leading from the front.
Floated on off, Finch blocks it.
Flighted on off, Warner strokes it to long off and eases down the other end.
On the body, Warner brings out the reverse sweep but misses. It hits him on his body but no pain.
Slower through the air on off, Finch runs it down towards backward point for one.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on. 6-0-29-0, his figures so far.
Short and turning in, Warner dabs it against the spin towards point.
On the pads again, Finch eases it to the leg side  and rotates the strike.
Floated on middle, Warner comes down the track and milks it to long on for a single.
Flighted on off, Finch plays a dominating sweep shot but there is a man at deep mid-wicket so just a single. Moves to 95.
On the pads, Finch tuck it to the leg side with the spin.
Floated on middle, Finch looks to defend but does so off the inside edge of his bat.

Drinks break!!! We are heading towards the end no prices for guessing who will win this match. Australia will be trying their biggest ODI win over India while India will be trying to take a couple of wickets to boost their morale a bit heading into the next game.
FOUR! Now this is through mid off. Slower delivery outside off, Warner does not care about the pace of it he smashes it through mid off for a boundary. Just 30 runs needed now.
FOUR! Length delivery outside off, Warner punches it with ease through covers for a boundary.
Another good pull but once again only for one. This time it is Aaron Finch.
Back of a length on off, Warner pulls it very nicely but there is protection at deep mid-wicket so just one.
Full again on stumps, Warner clears his front leg and looks to clear mid off but does not hit it well. Luckily for him it goes to the fielder on the bounce.
Full on middle, Finch guides it towards cover and gets a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up outside off, Finch pushes this down towards mid off for one.
Wide! Down the leg side, Finch looks to flick but misses.
Outside off, Finch plays this off the back foot towards point for a couple.
Floated on middle and off, Finch comes forward and defends.
SIX! Too easy! A floated delivery on off, Finch just lofts it over the long off region and the ball easily clears the fence. He is now eyeing his ton.
Floated on the pads, Finch fails to put bat on ball and is hit on the pad.
FOUR! Glorious! Full on middle, Warner takes his front leg away and drives it through mid off for another boundary. A day where even Bumrah is being taken to cleaners.
Short ball on off, Warner looks to play the upper cut but misses.
On off, Warner plays it to point.
Short ball on off, Warner looks to hook but misses.

FOUR! HUNDRED FOR DAVID WARNER! Brings out his trademark jump and punch celebration! This has been a brilliant innings. Even if you are an Indian fan you cannot hold back your applause. He has been in top gear from ball one. This man has been tremendous. Gets to his tin in style. There were a lot of talks on how he will perform in India and he has answered those questions with his bat. Gets to his 18th ton in style. Length ball outside off, Warner places this through the third man fence for a boundary. Warner removes his helmet and jumps in joy.
Good length delivery on middle. Warner dabs it to point and looks for a single but Finch sends him back.
jasprit Bumrah is back on. 5-0-31-0 his figures so far.
Flat and short outside off, Warner punches it to cover and keeps the strike. 59 needed off 120.
Floated on off, Finch milks it to long on for a single.
Another short ball but this one is punched to sweeper cover for a single.
FOUR! Crunching shot! Great placement! Short and spinning away, Warner gets on his back foot and punches it with power through extra cover for a boundary.
Flighted on off and middle, Warner defends it.
Floated on middle, Finch sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Kuldeep is back!
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

NOT OUT! Warner almost immediately took the review and again he has been saved by the inside edge.  Floated ball on middle and leg, Warner looks to paddle it towards fine leg but fails to do so. The ball hits the pads and the Indian players appeal and this time the finger goes up. Warner goes for the review and looked very confident. Replays rolled in and showed why as there is a clear spike on the Ultra Edge. Warner stays on the crease and will be eyeing his ton.

Warner has been adjudged LBW and he has taken it upstairs straightaway. Was there some bat involved? The indication from Warner suggests that because if there isn't any then he is a candidate of plumb. Replay rolls in and it shows that the bat is indeed involved. The Australian march continues!
On the pads, worked towards the leg side now.
Floated on off, defended towards the off side.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, Finch misses his flick and is hit on the boot. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batters steal a leg bye.
On the pads, Warner flicks this one towards backward square leg for one.
Back of a length ball on off, pulled towards square leg for one.
FOUR! Bouncer on middle and leg, Warner goes back and just helps it towards the fine leg fence. Kuldeep had no chance of reaching that one.
Bouncer on off, Warner looks to go for the upper cut but misses.
Full ball on the pads, Finch looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the leg side and the batters take a leg bye.
Length ball on off, played towards the point region for a single.
Fullish ball on off, driven towards cover for a single.
Floated on off, driven towards the cover fielder.
Floated on the pads, Finch looks to flick but misses. The ball rolls to the leg side and the batters take a leg bye.
On the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Warner goes back and plays this one to the man at point.
Another flatter delivery on off, pushed towards point for a single.
Flatter delivery on off, worked towards the off side.
On the pads now, full ball, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, blocked out.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side.
Outside off, Warner opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a single.
Length ball on middle and off, defended off the back foot.
On the pads, flicked towards the square leg region for one.
Wide! Down the leg side, Finch looks to flick but misses.
Shardul Thakur is back on! 3-0-32-0, his numbers today.
This time Warner rocks back and defends it off the back foot.
Warner prods forward and defends it off the front foot.
Finch goes onto the back foot and drives it towards cover for one.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Warner has pushed it down to long off for one.
EDGED AND FOUR! Floated on middle and off, Warner comes down the track and looks to loft it over the bowler but it goes off the inside edge towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Ravindra Jadeja is back on. He has conceded 20 runs so far in his 3 overs.
FOUR! Done it with ease! Good length ball outside off, Finch waits and then guides it fine towards third man. Kuldeep runs and dives to his left but cannot stop it from going to the fence.
Full on off, Aaron pushes it to mid on.
This time Finch finds the man at point.
FOUR! This time Finch punches and fetches another boundary. Good length ball outside off, Finch punches it through point and gets a boundary.

In the air but safe! Back of a length ball outside off, Finch punches it to the right of third man. Kuldeep goes for the catch but the ball gets there on a bounce. He fumbles but manages to keep it inside the ropes.
Outside off and full, Finch drives it to cover for a single.
Shorter on off, Warner plays it to point to get through the over.

SIX! Warner puts on his dancing shoes and slashes it over the long on fence for a biggie! Tossed up on middle and off, Warner comes down the track and lofts it from the middle of the bat over long on for a biggie. Just 100 needed now.
On the pads, Aaron turns it behind square and gets a single to get bring 150-run opening stand. 4th time that this duo has achieved that in ODIs.
Flighted on the pads, Finch sweeps it with one hand taking it on the full and gets a couple.
On the pads, Davey flicks it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Floated on middle and off, Warner comes down the track and strokes it to mid on.
Full on off, Finch squeezes it to covers for a single. 110 needed off 168.
Back of a length on off, Finch pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.

Jadeja still saving runs for his side. Superb fielding from the all-rounder. Good length ball outside off, Finch cuts it hard and it has boundary written all over it but Jadeja at point dives and saves it with his left hand.
Length ball outside off, Warner punches it to cover for a run.
On the pads, Warner turns it to mid-wicket.

No reviews left and Finch again survives. Floated delivery on middle, Finch looks to defend but the ball turns in and beats his inside edge. Yadav and his teammates put in a loud appeal but the umpire thinks it has hit the gloves. Kohli is baffled by that call but does not have a review to challenge that decision. The replays later roll in and show that even if it would have been reviewed, Finch would have been saved as the ball clipped the top of leg pole and it would have been umpire's call.
Wide! Down the leg side, Finch goes for a flick but misses.
Finch goes back and defends it off the back foot.
Floated delivery on off, Warner comes down the pitch and drives this one towards the cover region.
Warner prods forward and has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Finch plays the sweep shot and the ball goes towards square leg for a single.

NOT OUT! Kuldeep floats one outside off, Finch looks to play at it but misses. The ball goes past the outside edge and Rahul whips the bails off in a flash. Appeals and the leg umpire refers it upstairs. Replays roll in and Finch is well in.
Stumping appeal! Again Finch is the man in question. The Indians don't look too excited and the replays show why as Finch is comfortably in.
On the pads, Finch flicks it to the leg side for a single.

NOT OUT! Fat as panda inside edge there and to make matters worse India lose their review as well. Quicker one on middle and leg, Finch looks to defend but gets hit on the pads. Jadeja goes up in appeal but the umpire says no. Jadeja feels he has his man, Kohli also wants to review this but Rahul is not too keen. Kohli this time goes with his bowler and reviews it. Replay rolls in and it shows that there is a fat inside edge before it hit the pads. Ultra Edge confirms that and the one positive thing that India had was they had a review now they do not have that either.

Review time! Finch is the man in question. Rahul was against taking the review but Jadeja wanted it and Kohli has sided with his bowler. Replays roll in and show that there is an inside edge. Finch survives!
Tossed up on the stumps, Finch defends it towards cover and shouts his partner to wait.
Follows it up with a simple single to long on.
FOUR! Short and wide outside off, Warner cuts it through backward point. Bumrah at point dives but to no avail.
WIDE! Quicker down the leg side, Warner looks to flick but misses. Wided by the umpire.
Floated on middle, Warner defends it off the front foot.
Floats one on off, Finch pushes it to mid off. 123 needed in 186 balls.
Tossed up on off and middle, Warner comes down the track and squeezes it to sweeper cover for one.
Short and this one shoots up, Warner whips it to mid-wicket.
Flights one on off, Warner drives it through covers and gets a couple as the man at sweeper cover mops it up.
Floated on off, Finch defends it to the off side and gets a single.
FOUR! The crowd is silent and Australia are dealing in boundaries here. Short and just outside off, Finch cuts it through point for a boundary.
FOUR! Spanked away! Short and wide outside off, Warner smothers it through covers for a boundary.
On the pads, Aaron turns it to the leg side for a single.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
On the pads, Finch flicks it but finds mid-wicket.
On the stumps, defended by AF.
Floated on off, Finch looks to flick but it goes off the leading edge which goes towards third man for a couple.
Jadeja is back.
Warner goes back and cuts but finds the man at point.
Outside off, Finch plays this one towards point for a single.
On the pads, Warner flicks it down the leg side and the batters take a single.
Floated on off again, pushed down to mid off.
On middle and leg now, worked towards square leg for a single.
Floated on off, defended back towards the bowler.

DRINKS! Australia are cruising at the moment and India cannot find a way to take wickets with both Warner and Finch going strong. Their opening stand is unbeaten at 115 runs and if this goes on for any longer, India will then be completely out of this game. If the hosts need to stand any chance of a comeback, they will need wickets in a heap.
Length delivery on off, Warner glances it to the leg side.
On middle, Warner pushes it to mid on.

FIFTY FOR FINCH! Finally the skipper gets to his half ton. He was stuck on 49 for a long time but not anymore and now he can finally raise his bat. Good length ball on off, Finch defends it towards cover and takes a single to reach his 25th ODI fifty.
Bumrah special now. Yorker on middle, Finch jams it out.
WIDE! Jasprit misses his line and sprays one down the leg side. Wided by the umpire.

In the air and just over! Back of a length ball on off, Warner gets on his back foot and looks to pull. It goes off the upper half of his bat and goes over the jumping Manish Pandey at short mid-wicket. The batsmen take three.
Full on the pads, Warner looks to flick but misses and gets hit on the pads.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
On the pads, Finch glances it to mid-wicket.
Short on off, Finch punches it towards cover.

Appeal but the umpire is not interested. Short and just outside off, Finch looks to cut but misses. The ball just about goes over the edge. Rahul goes up in a hopeful celebration, Kuldeep asks umpire the question but he is unmoved.
Floated on off, Finch blocks it.

FIFTY FOR DAVID WARNER! He continues his superb white ball form. He will look to convert this into a big one and take his side over the line. Tossed up on middle, Warner comes down the track and milks it to long off to get to his 21st ODI fifty.
On the pads, flicked towards the man at square leg.
Outside off, Finch plays this ball towards the point region.

FOUR BYES! That has gone past everyone! Bumrah bowls a ball outside off and it comes back in massively, cutting Finch in half. He looks to defend but the ball goes between his body and bat. It beats Rahul's dive too and the ball races to the fine leg fence.
Length ball on middle and leg, worked towards the leg side for a single.
Outside off, Warner looks to cut but misses the ball completely.
FOUR! Back of a length ball on middle, Warner rocks back and pulls this one towards square leg for a boundary.
Jasprit Bumrah is back on!
Short on off, Finch punches it towards backward point. Just the maximum off the over but every run is taking this game away from India.
Tossed up on off, Aaron pushes it to cover.
Follows the maximum with a calm front foot defense.

SIX! The hundred run stand comes up in style! Kuldeep tosses this one up on middle, Finch smokes it straight over Kuldeep's head for a biggie. Finch raises his bat and thinks he has got to his fifty but he is on 49. Have to wait for another run skipper.
Shorter on off, Finch punches it to cover and calls for his partner to wait.
Gives this air on off, it turns back in. Finch guides it to point.
Short on off, Warnber punches it to cover. 7 off Jadeja's first.
SIX! Warner has gone the aerial route. Flighted on middle, Warner whacks his whip and the ball goes to the mid-wicket fence on the up for a biggie.
Tossed up on off, Warner taps it back to the bowler.
Darted on the pads, Finch looks to flick but misses. The ball goes to the leg side off his pad and they take a leg bye.
Shorter outside off, Finch punches it to cover and they are stuck at unlucky 87!
Jadeja starts with a floated delivery on middle, Finch blocks it away.
Ravindra Jadeja is on now.
Warner goes back in his crease and Warner defends it off the back foot.
Floated on off, pushed towards the man at cover.

Another edge and Finch is saved again! Floated on off, Finch looks to slog sweep this towards mid-wicket but the ball goes off the top edge towards third man and the batters take a single. Wondering where was Kuldeep for so long?
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.

On off, Warner plays this one towards the point region. Bumrah there throws the ball towards the non-striker's end with Finch out of his crease but the ball deflects off Kuldeep's thigh and goes towards mid on as the batters take an overthrow and change ends.

Almost! Finch could have easily been a goner. Floated delivery on middle and leg, Finch looks to work this one towards the leg side but the ball goes off the leading edge towards mid off. Powerplay 2 time! Now maximum of 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Spin to begin the second phase of the game. Kuldeep Yadav to have a go and Kohli needs him to break this partnership.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side. An awesome Powerplay for Australia as they are 84/0 at the end of 10 overs.
FOUR! Length ball outside off, Warner cuts this one off the back foot through the point region and the ball races away to the boundary.
Wide! Bouncer and it is way above Warner. Wide signalled!
Good length ball on off, driven towards cover and in the gap. Kohli from mid off runs across to his right and dives to keep it down to a couple.
On off, plays this one towards the point region for another single.
Warner plays this off the back foot towards cover-point for a single.
FOUR! Warner is in extremely good form here! Full ball on the off pole line, Warner makes room and drives this one powerfully through the cover region for a boundary.
This time Warner guides it towards third man and gets a single. He will keep strike in the next over.
Finch opens the face of the bat and guides it towards third man for one.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

FOUR! Excellent placement by Aaron Finch! He has been peppering the off side with his wonderful stroke-making. Length ball on off, Finch goes onto the back foot and punches it through point for a boundary.
Length ball on off,  punched the ball off the back foot towards the off side.
FOUR! Creamed! Full ball outside off, Finch comes onto the front foot and drives this one through the cover region for a superb boundary.
Mohammed Shami is back on! 3-0-18-0, his number so far.
On off, defended towards the man at cover.
SIX! Smashed! Back of a length ball on middle and off, Warner goes back and pulls this over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Length ball on middle and off, Warner defends it out.
Wide! Shardul misses his line and bowls it way outside off.
FOUR! Full ball on middle and leg, Warner just flicks it nonchalantly towards square leg for a boundary.
Back of a length ball on middle and off, defended by Warner.

Way outside off again, Finch goes after it but misses the ball.

Warner looks to pull and the ball goes to the keeper. The Indian players are up in celebration and the umpire raises his finger. This will also be a wide.

Howzaattt? The umpire says not good enough to raise his finger. Shardul starts with an inswinging delivery on off, Warner looks to defend but misses. Replay later on shows that the ball would have clipped the top of middle. The decision would have stayed with the on-field umpire's call.
